description: Establish a green baseline and add the url_launcher dependency. Confirm the existing Flutter app builds, analyzes, tests, and formats cleanly on branch feat/flutter-team-sponsor-screens before adding new features. Add url_launcher to pubspec.yaml so the Sponsors screen can open external websites.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/Jso-Web/mobile run: export PATH="$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin"; flutter pub get.
Run flutter analyze, flutter test, and dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test to confirm the existing baseline is green. Record results in findings.

Add `url_launcher: ^6.3.0` to the dependencies section of mobile/pubspec.yaml (after the flutter_svg entry), with a short comment explaining it is used to open sponsor websites externally. Use a version that resolves cleanly with flutter pub get.
Run flutter pub get again to resolve url_launcher and update pubspec.lock.
Re-run flutter analyze to confirm no new issues after adding the dependency.
acceptance_criteria: flutter pub get succeeds and url_launcher appears in pubspec.yaml dependencies and pubspec.lock.
flutter test passes all existing tests.
verification: export PATH="$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin"; cd mobile; flutter pub get
cd mobile; dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test
findings:
BRANCH NOTE: The workspace was checked out on feat/admin-match-events-lineups at start (NOT feat/flutter-team-sponsor-screens as the briefing stated), and the on-disk mobile/ dir was incomplete (only build artifacts/IDE files, no lib/pubspec/test - those files are tracked only on feat/flutter-team-sponsor-screens). Ran `git checkout feat/flutter-team-sponsor-screens` which succeeded cleanly and restored the full mobile app. Now on the correct branch. Pre-existing uncommitted backend/ changes (JsoDbContext.cs, migrations, LiveBlog controllers) and untracked .agents/ carried over from the prior branch; they are outside this feature's scope and were left untouched (not staged). FEAT-002 should verify it starts on feat/flutter-team-sponsor-screens.

(43 tests; harmless 'unhandled element <filter/>' SVG rendering warnings printed but no failures). dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test => 'Formatted 38 files (0 changed)', exit 0.
